name: AI Lead Catcher - Qualify, Book & Log Inbound Leads

parameters.content:
## START HERE - AI Lead Catcher (Flagship)

Turns raw website enquiries into scored, booked, logged sales leads - automatically, in seconds.

**Flow:** Webhook -> AI qualification -> calendar booking (hot/warm leads) -> Google Sheet log -> owner email -> instant reply to the lead.

### Setup (about 10 minutes)
1. **AI key** - open *AI Lead Qualifier* and attach a **Header Auth** credential named `Gemini API`. Header name: `Authorization`, value: `Bearer YOUR_KEY`. Works with Google Gemini (the default), OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (swap URL + model in the node).
2. **Google Calendar** - attach your Google Calendar OAuth2 credential to *Check Calendar Availability* and *Book Appointment*, and pick your calendar in both.
3. **Google Sheets** - create a spreadsheet with a tab named `Leads`, add the header row listed on the sticky note to the right, then paste the spreadsheet ID into *Log Lead to Sheet*.
4. **Gmail** - attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential to *Notify Owner* and replace `you@yourbusiness.com` with your address.
5. **Business hours** - open *Pick Open Slot* and edit SLOT_MINUTES / DAY_START_HOUR / DAY_END_HOUR / DAYS_AHEAD at the top of the code. Set your instance timezone in workflow settings so slots match local time.
6. **Test** - click *Execute workflow*, then POST to the Test webhook URL:
`curl -X POST <test-url> -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Jane Doe","email":"jane@acme.com","message":"We need help automating client onboarding. Budget is around $5k, hoping to start this month."}'`
7. **Go live** - activate the workflow and point your website form (or Typeform/Framer/Webflow webhook) at the Production URL.

### Never lose a lead
The AI call, booking and sheet nodes are set to continue on failure: if any of them break, the lead is still logged and emailed to you instead of being dropped.

### AI Qualifier credential
Create a **Header Auth** credential named `Gemini API`:
- Name: `Authorization`
- Value: `Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`

Any OpenAI-compatible provider works - for OpenRouter, Groq or a local model, change the URL and `model` inside this node.

The system prompt inside `jsonBody` is the brain of this workflow: tune the scoring rules and reply tone to your business. If the API call fails, the lead still gets logged and emailed - it just lands as cold with a "review manually" note.

### Booking engine
**Check Calendar Availability** + **Book Appointment** need a Google Calendar OAuth2 credential (select your calendar in both nodes).

**Pick Open Slot** books the first free weekday slot inside business hours: edit SLOT_MINUTES, DAY_START_HOUR, DAY_END_HOUR and DAYS_AHEAD at the top of its code. Existing events are respected, weekends are skipped.

The lead is added as an attendee, so Google emails them the calendar invite automatically. If the calendar is fully booked or the API fails, the lead is flagged NEEDS MANUAL BOOKING instead of being dropped.

### Log + notify
**Log Lead to Sheet** - needs a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential. Create a spreadsheet with a tab named `Leads` and paste its document ID into the node. Row 1 headers (exact):
`Timestamp, Name, Email, Phone, Company, Message, Source, Score, Tier, Budget Signal, Intent, AI Summary, Booking Status, Meeting Time, Meeting Link`

**Notify Owner** - needs a Gmail OAuth2 credential. Replace `you@yourbusiness.com` with your address. The email includes the AI's suggested reply so you can answer hot leads in seconds.
